stories.title: npm Trusted Publishing Flaw With 10 Million Downloads Exposes 1,500+ Packages to Malicious Takeover
stories.description: SlugFest flaw in npm Trusted Publishing exposed 1,500+ packages to takeover via reclaimed GitHub names, risking millions of downloads.

stories.description: A small circuit board hidden under the signers’ screens read user data and transmitted it to the attackers.

stories.description: Two Citrix NetScaler zero-days are exploited to deploy a modified Platypus remote access tool on vulnerable appliances.

stories.title: Cyberattack Prompts Ahold Delhaize to Disconnect Systems
stories.description: The company says it took some of its systems offline to contain a security issue within its network.

stories.title: Attackers Heat French Supermarket Fridges Up to 50°C by Hijacking Danfoss Controllers
stories.description: Danfoss controllers at hundreds of French supermarkets were compromised, with attackers forcing defrost and causing food losses at some stores.

stories.title: Two Critical MarkLogic Flaws Could Give Delegated Managers Persistent Admin Control
stories.description: Progress fixed 31 MarkLogic Server flaws in 11.3.7 and 12.1.0, including two that could give delegated accounts persistent admin control.

stories.title: GitLab Patches CVSS 10.0 Flaw That Could Let Unauthenticated Users Run Server Code
stories.description: GitLab fixed CVE-2026-97229 (CVSS 10.0), a CI/CD flaw that could allow unauthenticated code execution under certain conditions.

stories.title: Refrigeration Controller Hack Spoils Food Across European Supermarkets
stories.description: A cyberattack targeted refrigeration controllers, setting refrigerators and freezers across hundreds of supermarkets to defrost.

stories.title: Low-Cost Android Phones Ship With Preinstalled Malware That Turns Them Into Residential Proxies
stories.description: Midnight Mimosa ships in some low-cost Android firmware, silently installs apps, and uses payloads for ad fraud and residential proxies.
